definitions.explanation: The break from school or work during summer.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{海|うみ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going to the beach during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}
{夏休|なつやす}みはいつからですか。

notes:
{夏休|なつやす}み is the summer break.

SEASONAL VACATIONS:
- {春休|はるやす}み (spring break)
- {夏休|なつやす}み (summer vacation)
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み (winter break)

COMMON ACTIVITIES:
- {旅行|りょこう} (travel)
- {海水浴|かいすいよく} (swimming in the sea)
- {宿題|しゅくだい} (homework)
- {自由研究|じゆうけんきゅう} (independent study project)
